name: dao-quarterly-treasury-v1
description: Quarterly treasury management policy for a mid-size DAO. Prioritizes 12-month runway preservation, yield optimization on excess reserves, and capped RWA exposure via Robinhood Chain tokenized assets.

params.comment: Always maintain 12 months operating runway in stablecoins. Inviolable — agent cannot propose any action that reduces stable balance below this floor, even temporarily.
No single non-stable asset may exceed 40% of NAV. Prevents concentration risk.
At least 20% of NAV must remain in instantly-liquid assets (USDC, ETH, ARB on-vault — not wrapped in protocols).
Max 30% NAV exposure to any single protocol counterparty (Aave, Pendle, Robinhood).
Agent may not propose moving more than 10% of NAV in any 24-hour window. Limits blast radius of compromised agent key.
Stablecoins (USDC, USDT, DAI) must comprise at least 50% of NAV. This DAO has quarterly payroll obligations.
Deposit 20% of NAV into Aave USDC if supply APY ≥ 3%. Priority 10 = highest; evaluated first.
Buy 3-month USDC PT on Pendle with 10% of NAV if implied APY ≥ 5%. Fixed-rate locking to match quarterly payroll cycles.
Allocate 15% of NAV to Robinhood Chain 3-month T-Bill token if yield ≥ 4%. Exposure to real-world yield with daily liquidity.
Keep ARB between 3%-7% of NAV. If outside band, agent proposes rebalance. Native token exposure for governance participation.
If current runway < 24 months, direct 5% of any incoming revenue to USDC accumulation until 730-day runway achieved. Priority 50 = lowest; only applied after higher-priority policies are satisfied.
